_about: Era plates: one painted frontispiece per part of The Story. Source of truth for which image sits above which era and what its caption says. Images live in my-app/public/assets/img/lore/eras/<key>.jpg (1536x768) with a -768 variant for phones. Generated locally with Z-Image-Turbo in flat gouache; run and seed recorded so a plate can be regenerated. Captions are plain statements of what the plate shows, drawn from ratified lore only.

plates.alt: A field of shattered grey rock drifting in black space, one small intact planet and one dim star beyond it.
plates.caption: The Cybele system after the supernova of Joro: the Jorian Belt, Stonera alone among the wreckage, and a dying sun.

plates.alt: Rows of tall dark starships standing on landing struts on a paved field, low stone buildings behind them under a pale sky.
plates.caption: A Vallerii fleet at rest on a newly claimed world, the first colony blocks raised beside it.

plates.alt: A long dormitory hall of empty made-up beds leading to a great riveted machine disc ringed in cold blue light.
plates.caption: Quarters made ready for a generation that never came, and at the end of the hall the Tachyon Drive core whose radiation caused the Age of Unbirth.

plates.alt: An industrial complex on a volcanic plain, rows of black smokestacks either side of a straight channel of molten rock.
plates.caption: Magmuth in the boom years, its refineries built around the molten channels that made the corporations rich.

plates.alt: A tall mast on a mountain ridge with three straight white lines rising into a storm cloud, jagged lightning striking the peaks either side.
plates.caption: A Quantum Entanglement Device drawing on a Zolton bloodstorm: the link through which APEX reached every Generator at once.

plates.alt: A warship wrapped in fire plunging toward a city of tall dark towers under a sky crossed with weapon fire.
plates.caption: The Battle of Grimedes: a warship falls burning over the city as the last engagement of the End Wars plays out above.

plates.alt: An empty stone arena with tiered galleries around a round bronze floor.
plates.caption: Kozrak's arena on Valleron, empty before a tournament. Xalians fight here for the Scrambler Tokens that let their homeworlds be repopulated.
